main.description: Durable admission, idempotent on authenticated sender DID plus TID. Exact replay returns the original admission receipt. Different content under the same id is rejected. When the sender holds a live lease, the send must carry that leaseId and generation fence; a stale or missing fence is refused with LeaseMismatch.

schema.description: Sender DID must match service-auth iss.

critical.description: Sender-declared critical mail. Stored for later routing; does not change delivery yet.

woke.description: Sender-declared wake intent for this recipient, independent of encryption.

resolvedFrom.description: The name the sender addressed, from identity.resolveRecipient. The mailbox resolves it again at accept time and refuses RoleUnresolved unless it still resolves to the envelope's recipient. Recorded on the receipt and traffic entry.

errors.name: LeaseMismatch
errors.description: Missing or stale sender lease fence.

errors.name: Retired
errors.description: The recipient name is retired. The message reads '<name> was retired at <datetime>; current row is <successor>' or ends '; no successor'. Nothing was admitted.

errors.name: RoleUnresolved
errors.description: resolvedFrom no longer resolves to the envelope's recipient, or its chain cycles or needs more than 3 hops. Resolve again and seal to the new recipient. Nothing was admitted.

errors.name: Conflict
errors.description: The same sender DID plus TID exists with a different envelope or recipient.

errors.name: UnsupportedEnvelope
errors.description: Unsupported envelope version or encryption suite.

errors.name: MailboxUnavailable
errors.description: Durable admission not confirmed; retry the same id with fresh service auth.
